notes.title: Critical bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that made the game crash/freeze when you select a new recruit mission.
this shouldn't have happened, sorry ^^

notes.title: Small bugfixes and balance changes
notes.notes:
This small update addresses some problems that have been reported, as well as small calculation inaccuracies that I have found in the code.


 Support for ultrawide screens have been added. the UI will no hopefully no longer break for users with uncommon aspect ratios
 Save system has been changed, this will break current runs but new saves are more stable.
 UI panels now remember their status, if a panel has been closed it will stay closed even between missions
 Fixed a calculation problem regarding Accuracy for weapons.
 Fixed a calculation problem with firerate scaling with reload speed boost instead of RPM boost
 Fixed negative firerates giving the unit infinite firerate by adding a minimum of 1RPM to the calculation
 Misc. balance changes

notes.title: Small bugfix and description addition
notes.notes:
Fixed a small bug where Meta-tech equipment initialized with 5 oxygen pillars instead of the essential equipment in some circumstances.

Added stats to the description of airstrikes and defenses so you can now see things like damage and fire rate of turrets.

notes.title: Customization Update
notes.notes:
Added the ability to Customize your units.
Color customization, which tints the icon.
Nicknames to give every unit a name

Quality of life
While building stuff you now get a preview icon, and a preview range.
Lamp glow strength now also scales with the "Range Research"
